        "contents": "const SourceSidebar: React.FC&lt;SourceSidebarProps&gt; = ({\n  sources = [],\n  selectedSources = [],\n  onSourcesChange,\n  onSelectionChange,\n  pageType,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showTextModal, setShowTextModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showKnowledgeBrowser, setShowKnowledgeBrowser] = useState(false);\n  const [editingSource, setEditingSource] = useState&lt;Source | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isSelectAll, setIsSelectAll] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleAddSource = () =&gt; {\n    setShowTextModal(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleExplore = () =&gt; {\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectAll = () =&gt; {\n    const newSelectAll = !isSelectAll;\n    setIsSelectAll(newSelectAll);\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      if (newSelectAll) {\n        onSelectionChange(sources.map((s) =&gt; s.id));\n      } else {\n        onSelectionChange([]);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSourceToggle = (sourceId: string) =&gt; {\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      const newSelection = selectedSources.includes(sourceId)\n        ? selectedSources.filter((id) =&gt; id !== sourceId)\n        : [...selectedSources, sourceId];\n      onSelectionChange(newSelection);\n      setIsSelectAll(newSelection.length === sources.length &amp;&amp; sources.length &gt; 0);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSourceClick = (source: Source) =&gt; {\n    setEditingSource(source);\n  };\n\n  const handleUpdateSource = (updatedSource: Source) =&gt; {\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      const newSources = sources.map((s) =&gt;\n        s.id === updatedSource.id ? updatedSource : s\n      );\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\n    }\n    setEditingSource(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const StudioSidebar: React.FC&lt;StudioSidebarProps&gt; = ({\n  outputs = [],\n  conversations = [],\n  onShowConversationList,\n  onTriggerFeature,\n  executingFeatureId,\n  statusMessage,\n  onShowFieldMappingConfig,\n  studioTitle = \"更多工具箱\",\n  featureLabelMap = {},\n  enabledToolIds,\n  pageType,\n  onDeleteConversation,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [selectedConversation, setSelectedConversation] = useState&lt;Conversation | null&gt;(null);\n  const [showDetailModal, setShowDetailModal] = useState(false);\n\n  const formatDaysAgo = (date: Date) =&gt; {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date);\n    const diff = now.getTime() - d.getTime();\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (days &lt; 1) return \"今天\";\n    if (days &lt; 30) return &#96;${days}天前&#96;;\n    if (days &lt; 365) return &#96;${Math.floor(days / 30)}个月前&#96;;\n    return &#96;${Math.floor(days / 365)}年前&#96;;\n  };\n\n  // 获取对话的首个问题作为标题\n  const getFirstQuestion = (conversation: Conversation): string =&gt; {\n    // 优先从消息中获取首个用户问题\n    if (conversation.messages &amp;&amp; conversation.messages.length &gt; 0) {\n      const firstUserMsg = conversation.messages.find((msg) =&gt; msg.role === \"user\");\n      if (firstUserMsg &amp;&amp; firstUserMsg.content) {\n        // 截取前50个字符作为标题\n        const content = firstUserMsg.content.trim();\n        if (content) {\n          return content.length &gt; 50 ? content.substring(0, 50) + \"...\" : content;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    // 如果没有用户消息，尝试从标题中提取（如果标题不是默认的时间戳格式）\n    if (conversation.title &amp;&amp; !conversation.title.startsWith(\"对话 \")) {\n      return conversation.title;\n    }\n    // 最后的后备方案\n    return \"新对话\";\n  };\n\n  const handleConversationClick = (conversation: Conversation) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedConversation(conversation);\n    setShowDetailModal(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, conversationId: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 554,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 输入源选择器组件\n * 支持选择上游节点的输出作为当前节点的输入\n */\nconst InputSourceSelector: React.FC&lt;InputSourceSelectorProps&gt; = ({\n  currentNodeId,\n  nodes,\n  edges,\n  inputSources = {},\n  onChange,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [expandedNodes, setExpandedNodes] = useState&lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set());\n  const [showPreview, setShowPreview] = useState(false);\n\n  // 查找所有上游节点（通过边连接关系）\n  const upstreamNodes = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    const upstreamNodeIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n    \n    // 通过边的连接关系找到所有直接连接到当前节点的上游节点\n    edges.forEach(edge =&gt; {\n      if (edge.target === currentNodeId) {\n        upstreamNodeIds.add(edge.source);\n      }\n    });\n    \n    // 递归查找间接上游节点（处理多层级连接）\n    let hasChanges = true;\n    const maxDepth = 10; // 防止无限循环\n    let depth = 0;\n    \n    while (hasChanges &amp;&amp; depth &lt; maxDepth) {\n      hasChanges = false;\n      depth++;\n      \n      nodes.forEach(node =&gt; {\n        if (!upstreamNodeIds.has(node.id) &amp;&amp; node.id !== currentNodeId) {\n          // 检查是否有边连接到已找到的上游节点\n          const isConnected = edges.some(edge =&gt; {\n            const isSource = edge.source === node.id;\n            const isTarget = upstreamNodeIds.has(edge.target);\n            return isSource &amp;&amp; isTarget;\n          });\n          \n          if (isConnected) {\n            upstreamNodeIds.add(node.id);\n            hasChanges = true;\n          }\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    \n    return nodes.filter(node =&gt; upstreamNodeIds.has(node.id));\n  }, [nodes, edges, currentNodeId]);\n\n  // 切换节点展开/收起状态\n  const toggleNode = (nodeId: string) =&gt; {\n    const newExpanded = new Set(expandedNodes);\n    if (newExpanded.has(nodeId)) {\n      newExpanded.delete(nodeId);\n    } else {\n      newExpanded.add(nodeId);\n    }\n    setExpandedNodes(newExpanded);\n  };\n\n  // 获取节点的输出字段列表（使用标准化的字段定义）\n  const getNodeOutputs = (node: AgentWorkflowNode)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n      const pageTypeToLoad = projectId ? &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96; : config.pageType;\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', pageTypeToLoad);\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(pageTypeToLoad);\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\n        success: sourceResult.success,\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n        error: sourceResult.error\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          // 先添加现有来源\n          prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n      } else {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到页面类型的来源信息');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\", error);\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\n;",

        "contents": "const FEATURE_LABEL_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  \"five-view-analysis\": \"技术转译\",\n  \"three-fix-analysis\": \"用户场景挖掘\",\n  \"tech-matrix\": \"发布会场景化\",\n  \"propagation-strategy\": \"领导人口语化\",\n  \"exhibition-video\": \"展具与视频\",\n  translation: \"翻译\",\n  \"ppt-outline\": \"技术讲稿\",\n  script: \"脚本\",\n};\n\nconst MessageItem: React.FC&lt;MessageItemProps&gt; = ({\n  message,\n  onCopy,\n  onSave,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);\n  const [saved, setSaved] = React.useState(false);\n  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = React.useState&lt;\"text\" | \"structured\"&gt;(\"text\");\n\n  const handleCopy = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(message.content);\n      setCopied(true);\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; setCopied(false), 2000);\n      if (onCopy) {\n        onCopy(message.content);\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"复制失败:\", err);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = () =&gt; {\n    setSaved(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setSaved(false), 2000);\n    if (onSave) {\n      onSave(message.content);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const formatTime = (value: Date | string) =&gt; {\n    const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diff = now.getTime() - date.getTime();\n    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);\n    \n    if (minutes &lt; 1) return \"刚刚\";\n    if (minutes &lt; 60) return &#96;${minutes}分钟前&#96;;\n    if (minutes &lt; 1440) return &#96;${Math.floor(minutes / 60)}小时前&#96;;\n    \n    return date.toLocaleDateString(\"zh-CN\", {\n      month: \"short\",\n      day: \"numeric\",\n      hour: \"2-digit\",\n      minute: \"2-digit\",\n    });\n  };\n\n  const isUser = message.role === \"user\";\n  const featureType = message.outputs?.metadata?.featureType;\n  const featureLabel = featureType ? {\n      try {\n        return JSON.parse(value);\n      } catch {\n        return null;\n      }\n    };\n\n    if (rawContent &amp;&amp; typeof rawContent === \"object\") {\n      return rawContent;\n    }\n\n    if (typeof rawContent === \"string\") {\n      const trimmed = rawContent.trim();\n      if (!trimmed) {\n        return null;\n      }\n\n      if (\n        (trimmed.startsWith(\"{\") &amp;&amp;         "contents": "const AIChatPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 快捷操作处理函数\n  const handleCopyMessage = async (content: string) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);\n      // 可以添加复制成功的提示\n      console.log('消息已复制到剪贴板');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('复制失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleLikeMessage = (messageId: string) =&gt; {\n    setMessages(prev =&gt; prev.map(msg =&gt; \n      msg.id === messageId \n        ? { ...msg, liked: !msg.liked, disliked: false }\n        : msg\n    ));\n  };\n\n  const handleDislikeMessage = (messageId: string) =&gt; {\n    setMessages(prev =&gt; prev.map(msg =&gt; \n      msg.id === messageId \n        ? { ...msg, disliked: !msg.disliked, liked: false }\n        : msg\n    ));\n  };\n\n  const handleRegenerateMessage = async (messageId: string) =&gt; {\n    // 找到要重新生成的消息\n    const messageToRegenerate = messages.find(msg =&gt; msg.id === messageId);\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\n 'field-mapping-management'\n];\n\n/**\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\n */\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { address } = useParams&lt;{ address: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!address) {\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        setError(null);\n        // 根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n        } else {\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\n        }\n      } catch (err: any) {\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\n          navigate('/');\n          return;\n        }\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [address, navigate]);\n\n  // 处理节点执行\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const TechPointLibraryPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.deleteTechPoint(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        message.success('删除成功');\n        // 重新加载数据，确保与后端同步（后端是软删除，状态变为archived）\n        await loadTechPoints();\n      } else {\n        message.error(response.error || '删除失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除技术点失败:', error);\n      message.error('删除失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleViewDetail = (techPoint: TechPoint, event?: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    if (isSelectMode) {\n      // 选择模式下，点击行切换选中状态\n      // 如果点击的是复选框，不处理（由复选框自己处理）\n      if (event?.target instanceof HTMLElement &amp;&amp; event.target.closest('.ant-checkbox-wrapper')) {\n        return;\n      }\n      toggleSelectTechPoint(techPoint.id);\n    } else {\n      navigate(&#96;/tech-point-library/${techPoint.id}&#96;, {\n        state: { from: '/tech-point-library' }\n      });\n    }\n  };\n\n  const toggleSelectTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedTechPointIds(prev =&gt; \n      prev.includes(techPointId)\n        ? prev.filter(id =&gt; id !== techPointId)\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\n    );\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectAll = (checked: boolean) =&gt; {\n    if (checked) {\n      setSelectedTechPointIds(techPoints.map(tp =&gt; tp.id));\n    } else {\n      setSelectedTechPointIds([]);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleConfirmSelection = () =&gt; {\n    if (selectedTechPointIds.length === 0) {\n      message.warning('请至少选择一个技术点');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    // 将选中的技术点ID传回\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\n    params.append('selectedTechPointIds', selectedTechPointIds.join(','));\n    navigate(&#96;${returnUrl}?${params.toString()}&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleCancelSelection = () =&gt; {\n    navigate(returnUrl);\n  };\n\n  const handleModalSuccess = () =&gt; {\n    setEditModalVisible(false);\n;\n;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/NODE_CONFIGURATION_ANALYSIS.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 51
          }
        },
        "contents": "# 项目节点配置需求与有效节点分析\n\n本文档详细分析了项目中需要配置的节点类型，以及前端页面中实际使用的有效节点。\n\n## 一、需要配置的节点类型\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\n\n这些节点对应独立的页面路由，需要配置AI角色（source: 'independent-page'）：\n\n| 节点ID | 节点名称 | 路由路径 | 页面组件 | 状态 |\n|--------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;ai-search&#96; | AI问答 | &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | AiSearchNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | TechPackageNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | PromotionStrategyNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;core-draft&#96; | 核心稿件 | &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | CoreDraftNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;speech&#96; | 演讲稿 | &#96;/node/speech&#96; | PressReleasePage | ✅ 有效（映射到press-release） |\n\n**配置要求：**\n- 需要在AI角色管理系统中创建对应的AI角色\n- source必须设置为 &#96;'independent-page'&#96;\n- 角色ID或名称需要匹配节点类型（通过正则表达式匹配）\n- 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\n\n**匹配规则（见 &#96;nodeRoleMapping.ts&#96;）：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ai-search 匹配模式\n/ai-search/i, /ai问答/i, /智能搜索/i, /smart-search/i\n\n// tech-package 匹配模式\n/tech-package/i, /技术包装/i\n\n// promotion-strategy 匹配模式\n/promotion-strategy/i, /tech-strategy/i, /技术策略/i, /推广策略/i\n\n// core-draft 匹配模式\n/core-draft/i, /tech-article/i, /技术通稿/i, /核心稿件/i\n\n// speech 匹配模式\n/speech/i, /发布会/i, /演讲稿/i, /tech-publish/i\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 标准页面节点（5个）\n\n这些是标准化的独立页面，使用BaseAISearchPage组件：\n\n| 页面类型 | 页面名称 | 路由路径 | 配置文件 | 状态 |\n|---------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/tech-package&#96; | techPackageConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | techStrategyConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-article&#96; | 技术通稿 | &#96;/tech-article&#96; | techArticleConfig | ✅ 有效 |",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 项目节点配置需求与有效节点分析",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "本文档详细分析了项目中需要配置的节点类型，以及前端页面中实际使用的有效节点。",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## 一、需要配置的节点类型",
            "lineNumber": 5

          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）",
            "lineNumber": 7

          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "这些节点对应独立的页面路由，需要配置AI角色（source: 'independent-page'）：",
            "lineNumber": 9

          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "| 节点ID | 节点名称 | 路由路径 | 页面组件 | 状态 |",

          },
          {
            "text": "|--------|---------|---------|---------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;ai-search&#96; | AI问答 | &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | AiSearchNode | ✅ 有效 |",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;speech&#96; | 演讲稿 | &#96;/node/speech&#96; | PressReleasePage | ✅ 有效（映射到press-release） |",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "**配置要求：**",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- 需要在AI角色管理系统中创建对应的AI角色",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- source必须设置为 &#96;'independent-page'&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- 角色ID或名称需要匹配节点类型（通过正则表达式匹配）",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "**匹配规则（见 &#96;nodeRoleMapping.ts&#96;）：**",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "// ai-search 匹配模式",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "/ai-search/i, /ai问答/i, /智能搜索/i, /smart-search/i",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "// tech-package 匹配模式",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "/tech-package/i, /技术包装/i",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "// promotion-strategy 匹配模式",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "/promotion-strategy/i, /tech-strategy/i, /技术策略/i, /推广策略/i",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "// core-draft 匹配模式",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "/core-draft/i, /tech-article/i, /技术通稿/i, /核心稿件/i",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "// speech 匹配模式",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "/speech/i, /发布会/i, /演讲稿/i, /tech-publish/i",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 标准页面节点（5个）",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "这些是标准化的独立页面，使用BaseAISearchPage组件：",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "| 页面类型 | 页面名称 | 路由路径 | 配置文件 | 状态 |",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "|---------|---------|---------|---------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/tech-package&#96; | techPackageConfig | ✅ 有效 |",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "| &#96;tech-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | techStrategyConfig | ✅ 有效 |",

          },

        ]

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./frontend/src/components/TopNavigation.tsx",

          }
        },
        "contents": "const TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = \nconst mainItems: NavigationItem[] = () =&gt; {\n\n    return items;\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\n\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    return MANAGEMENT_NAV_ORDER.map((navItem) =&gt; ({\n      id: navItem.path,\n      label: navItem.name,\n      icon: navItem.icon,\n      path: navItem.path,\n      disabled: false,\n      category: 'management' as const,\n    }));\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleNavigation = (path: string, disabled?: boolean, itemId?: string) =&gt; {\n    if (disabled) {\n      return;\n    }\n    // 如果是项目管理（首页），添加 tab=all 参数\n    if (path === '/' &amp;&amp; itemId === 'home') {\n      navigate('/?tab=all');\n    } else {\n      navigate(path);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const isCurrentPath = (path: string) =&gt; {\n    // 首页特殊处理\n    if (path === '/') {\n      // 检查是否是首页路径（忽略查询参数）\n      return location.pathname === '/' || location.pathname === '/tech-package';\n    }\n    // Agent配置特殊处理：如果当前路径是Agent配置的子页面，也认为是当前路径\n    if (path === '/ai-management') {\n      return AGENT_CONFIG_PATHS.some(agentPath =&gt; \n        location.pathname === agentPath || location.pathname.startsWith(agentPath + '/')\n      );\n    }\n    // 精确匹配\n    return location.pathname === path || location.pathname.startsWith(path + '/');\n  };\n\n  // 渲染导航按钮组\n  const renderNavGroup = (items: NavigationItem[], groupIndex: number)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "# 项目节点配置需求与有效节点分析\n\n本文档详细分析了项目中需要配置的节点类型，以及前端页面中实际使用的有效节点。\n\n## 一、需要配置的节点类型\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\n\n这些节点对应独立的页面路由，需要配置AI角色（source: 'independent-page'）：\n\n| 节点ID | 节点名称 | 路由路径 | 页面组件 | 状态 |\n|--------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;ai-search&#96; | AI问答 | &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | AiSearchNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | TechPackageNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | PromotionStrategyNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;core-draft&#96; | 核心稿件 | &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | CoreDraftNode | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;speech&#96; | 演讲稿 | &#96;/node/speech&#96; | PressReleasePage | ✅ 有效（映射到press-release） |\n\n**配置要求：**\n- 需要在AI角色管理系统中创建对应的AI角色\n- source必须设置为 &#96;'independent-page'&#96;\n- 角色ID或名称需要匹配节点类型（通过正则表达式匹配）\n- 支持Dify类型和Direct Agent类型\n\n**匹配规则（见 &#96;nodeRoleMapping.ts&#96;）：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ai-search 匹配模式\n/ai-search/i, /ai问答/i, /智能搜索/i, /smart-search/i\n\n// tech-package 匹配模式\n/tech-package/i, /技术包装/i\n\n// promotion-strategy 匹配模式\n/promotion-strategy/i, /tech-strategy/i, /技术策略/i, /推广策略/i\n\n// core-draft 匹配模式\n/core-draft/i, /tech-article/i, /技术通稿/i, /核心稿件/i\n\n// speech 匹配模式\n/speech/i, /发布会/i, /演讲稿/i, /tech-publish/i\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 标准页面节点（5个）\n\n这些是标准化的独立页面，使用BaseAISearchPage组件：\n\n| 页面类型 | 页面名称 | 路由路径 | 配置文件 | 状态 |\n|---------|---------|---------|---------|------|\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/tech-package&#96; | techPackageConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | techStrategyConfig | ✅ 有效 |\n| &#96;tech-article&#96; | 技术通稿 | &#96;/tech-article&#96; | techArticleConfig | ✅ 有效 |",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "### 2. 页面组件映射\n\n| 页面路由 | 页面组件 | 使用的节点组件 | 配置来源 |\n|---------|---------|--------------|---------|\n| &#96;/tech-package&#96; | TechPackagePage | BaseAISearchPage | techPackageConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-strategy&#96; | TechStrategyPage | BaseAISearchPage | techStrategyConfig |\n| &#96;/tech-article&#96; | TechArticlePage | BaseAISearchPage | techArticleConfig |\n| &#96;/press-release&#96; | PressReleasePage | BaseAISearchPage | pressReleaseConfig |\n| &#96;/ai-qa&#96; | AIQAPage | BaseAISearchPage | aiQaConfig |\n| &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/ai-qa&#96; | NodePage | AiSearchNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | NodePage | TechPackageNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | NodePage | PromotionStrategyNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | NodePage | CoreDraftNode | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n| &#96;/node/speech&#96; | NodePage | PressReleasePage | 公开页面配置或AI角色 |\n\n### 3. 工作流编辑器节点\n\n工作流编辑器（&#96;/agent-workflow&#96;）中可用的节点类型：\n\n| 节点类型 | 是否有效 | 使用场景 |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;agent&#96; | ✅ 是 | 调用AI角色执行任务 |\n| &#96;input&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输入 |\n| &#96;output&#96; | ✅ 是 | 定义工作流输出 |\n| &#96;condition&#96; | ✅ 是 | 条件分支判断 |\n| &#96;assign&#96; | ✅ 是 | 变量赋值 |\n| &#96;merge&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据合并 |\n| &#96;transform&#96; | ✅ 是 | 数据转换 |\n| &#96;memory&#96; | ✅ 是 | 文本存储 |\n\n## 三、节点配置依赖关系\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点配置流程\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1. 创建AI角色\n   ├─ source: 'independent-page'\n   ├─ provider: 'dify' 或 'direct-agent'\n   └─ 名称/ID匹配节点类型\n\n2. 配置Dify连接（如果provider为dify）\n   ├─ connectionType: 'chatflow' 或 'workflow'\n   ├─ apiKey: Dify API密钥\n   └─ apiUrl: Dify服务器地址\n\n3. 配置Direct Agent（如果provider为direct-agent）\n   ├─ LLM配置（apiKey, apiBaseUrl, model）",

        "contents": "const sourceService = {\n,\n\n  /**\n   * 批量保存来源信息到数据库\n   */\n  async saveSourceInformationBatch(\n    sources: Source[],\n    pageType?: string,\n    conversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: SourceInformation[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const sourceInfoList: Partial&lt;SourceInformation&gt;[] = sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n        // 构建 metadata，包含 category\n        const metadata: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n        if (source.category) {\n          metadata.category = source.category;\n        }\n        \n        return {\n          source_id: source.id,\n          title: source.title,\n          type: source.type,\n          url: source.url,\n          description: source.description,\n          page_type: pageType as any,\n          conversation_id: conversationId,\n          status: \"active\",\n          metadata: Object.keys(metadata).length &gt; 0 ? metadata : undefined,\n        };\n      });\n\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息:', {\n        count: sourceInfoList.length,\n        pageType,\n        conversationId,\n        sources: sourceInfoList.map(s =&gt; ({ source_id: s.source_id, title: s.title }))\n      });\n\n      const response = await api.post(\"/source-information/batch\", sourceInfoList);\n      console.log('[SourceService] 批量保存响应:', {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        dataCount: response.data.data?.length || 0,\n        error: response.data.error\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        success: response.data.success,\n        data: response.data.data,\n        error: response.data.error,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 批量保存来源信息失败:\", error);\n      console.error(\"[SourceService] 错误详情:\", {\n        message: error.message,\n        response: error.response?.data,\n        status: error.response?.status\n      });\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.response?.data?.error || error.message || \"批量保存来源信息失败\",\n      };\n    }\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID加载来源信息\n   */\n  async loadSourceInformationByConversationId(\n    conversationId: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    data?: Source[];\n    error?: string;\n  }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n,\n};",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \n\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n      try {\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\n        const summaryPrompt = &#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\n标题：[标题]\n摘要：[摘要内容]\n\n对话内容：\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n          summaryPrompt,\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;&amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\n          undefined\n        );\n\n        if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\s*(.+)/);\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\s*(.+?)(?:\\n|$)/s);\n          \n          if (titleMatch &amp;&amp; titleMatch[1]) {\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\n          }\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;&amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\n            if (summaryDescription.length &lt; 200) {\n              summaryDescription = &#96;${summaryDescription}\\n\\n完整对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\n        summaryTitle = messagesToUse.length &gt; 0 \n          ? &#96;项目对话摘要（${messagesToUse.length}条消息）&#96;\n          : '项目对话摘要';\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      const sourceId = &#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: summaryTitle\n      };\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&gt;) =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    \n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'user');\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\n    \n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\n    try {\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\n        try {\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\n            await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&#96;);\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\n      \n      if (savedId) {\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\n        \n        // 刷新历史记录\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\n        // 更新历史记录列表，但不自动切换视图（避免强制跳回历史记录页面）\n        await checkHistoryRecords(false); // 传入 false 表示不自动切换视图\n        \n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&gt;): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; =&gt; {\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\n    \n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &#96;project-${projectId}&#96; : undefined);\n\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\n    try {\n      // 构建对话文本\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&gt; {\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\n        return &#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&#96;;\n      }).join('\\n\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\n      const maxLength = 2000;\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\n\\n...（内容已截断）'\n        : conversationText;\n\n      // 生成总结（简化版本：使用对话内容作为描述，标题为总结）\n      // 如果对话很长，取前100字符作为标题\n      let summaryTitle = '项目资源对话摘要';\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n;\n;",

          }
        },
        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n        \n        // 从数据库加载该对话的来源信息（仅在非追加模式下加载，避免重复）\n        if (!options?.append) {\n          try {\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载对话来源信息:', conversationId);\n            const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 对话来源加载结果:', {\n              success: sourceResult.success,\n              count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n              error: sourceResult.error\n            });\n            \n            const dbSources = sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data ? sourceResult.data : [];\n            const conversationSources = detail.sources || [];\n            \n            // 合并所有来源：现有来源 + 对话来源 + 数据库来源\n            setSources(prev =&gt; {\n              const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n              \n              // 1. 先添加现有的来源（包括页面类型的来源）\n              prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 2. 添加对话中的来源\n              conversationSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 3. 添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n              dbSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n              console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n                prev: prev.length,\n                conversation: conversationSources.length,\n                db: dbSources.length\n              });\n              return merged;\n            });\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载对话来源信息失败:\", error);\n            // 如果加载失败，至少保留对话中的来源\n    }\n;\n;",

cleanLine.substring(0, maxTitleLength) + '...'\n            : cleanLine;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      const sourceId = &#96;project_translation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: title,\n        type: 'external',\n        description: translatedContent,\n        category: 'technical-translation', // 技术转译信息\n      };\n\n      // 保存到数据库\n      const saveResult = await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\n        source,\n        targetPageType,\n        aiConversationId || undefined\n      );\n\n      if (saveResult.success &amp;&amp; saveResult.data) {\n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 技术转译内容已保存:', {\n          sourceId: saveResult.data.source_id,\n          title: saveResult.data.title,\n          pageType: targetPageType\n        });\n        return saveResult.data.source_id;\n      } else {\n        console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:', saveResult.error);\n        return null;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 保存选中的 Web Search 结果为来源信息\n  const handleSaveWebSearchResults = async () =&gt; {\n    if (selectedSearchResults.size === 0) {\n      alert('请至少选择一个搜索结果');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!projectId) {\n      alert('项目ID不存在');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsAddingInternetInfo(true);\n    try {\n      const pageType = &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;;\n      const selectedResults = Array.from(selectedSearchResults).map(index =&gt; webSearchResults[index]);\n      \n      // 批量保存选中的搜索结果\n      for (const result of selectedResults) {\n        const sourceId = &#96;web_search_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n        const description = &#96;${result.snippet || ''}\\n\\n${result.summary ? &#96;摘要：${result.summary}&#96; : ''}\\n\\n来源：${result.siteName || ''}&#96;.trim();\n        \n        const source: Source = {\n          id: sourceId,\n          title: result.name || '未命名网页',\n          type: 'external',\n          url: result.url,\n          description: description,\n          category: 'web-search',\n        };\n\n        await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\n          source,\n          pageType,\n          aiConversationId || undefined\n        );\n      }\n\n      // 刷新来源列表\n      await loadSources();\n      \n      // 清空状态并关闭弹窗\n      setWebSearchQuery('');\n      setWebSearchResults([]);\n      setSelectedSearchResults(new Set());\n      setShowInternetInfoModal(false);\n      \n      alert(&#96;成功添加 ${selectedResults.length} 个搜索结果&#96;);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存 Web Search 结果失败:', error);\n      alert('保存失败，请重试');\n    } finally {\n      setIsAddingInternetInfo(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 保存技术转译内容为来源信息\n;",

'...' : ''),\n      status: 'active'\n    });\n\n    // 2. 保存用户消息\n    const userMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: &#96;user_${response.id}_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'user',\n      content: userQuery,\n      query: userQuery,\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(response.metadata.retriever_resources) : undefined,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    return { conversation, userMessage, assistantMessage };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify工作流响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n    response: DifyWorkflowResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any,\n    existingConversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; workflowExecution: WorkflowExecutionRecord }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/conversation/:conversationId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const { conversationId } = req.params;\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取对话来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取对话来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

需要逐个执行语句\n      const statements = [\n        &#96;CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n          source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')),\n          url TEXT,\n          description TEXT,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          conversation_id TEXT,\n          metadata TEXT,\n          status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n          created_by TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME source_information(source_id)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type)&#96;,\n        &#96;CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS source_information(created_at)&#96;\n      ];\n      \n      for (const sql of statements) {\n        try {\n          await db.query(sql);\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          // 忽略表或索引已存在的错误\n         "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource = async \n', saveResult.error);\n        return null;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 保存技术转译内容失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 处理跳转到技术策略或技术包装页面\n  const handleNavigateToAIPage = async (pageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-package') =&gt; {\n    // 收集所有需要保存的来源 ID\n    const sourceIds: string[] = [];\n    \n    // 1. 总结并保存对话内容\n    const conversationSourceId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(pageType);\n    if (conversationSourceId) {\n      sourceIds.push(conversationSourceId);\n    }\n    \n    // 2. 保存技术转译内容\n    const translationSourceId = await saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource(pageType);\n    if (translationSourceId) {\n      sourceIds.push(translationSourceId);\n    }\n    \n    // 构建跳转 URL\n    let url = &#96;/${pageType}&#96;;\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\n    \n    if (projectId) {\n      params.append('projectId', projectId);\n      // 添加 newConversation 参数，确保创建新对话\n      params.append('newConversation', 'true');\n    }\n    \n    // 添加所有 sourceId（支持多个）\n    sourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&gt; {\n      params.append('sourceId', sourceId);\n    });\n    \n    if (params.toString()) {\n      url += &#96;?${params.toString()}&#96;;\n    }\n\n    // 跳转\n    navigate(url);\n  };\n\n  if (loading || checkingHistory) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!project) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-gray-500\"&gt;项目不存在&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n;",

        "contents": "import DifyClient from '@/services/DifyClient';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nimport { ExecuteSpeechDTO } from '../dto/executeSpeech.dto';\n\nexport class ExecuteSpeechUseCase {\n  async execute(dto: ExecuteSpeechDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;unknown&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const inputs = dto.inputs ?? {};\n      const speechInputs: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {\n        'sys.query': inputs['sys.query'] || inputs.query || '请根据提供的补充信息生成技术发布会稿',\n      };\n\n      if (inputs.Additional_information &amp;&amp; String(inputs.Additional_information).trim() !== '') {\n        speechInputs.Additional_information = inputs.Additional_information;\n      } else if (inputs.coreDraft &amp;&amp; String(inputs.coreDraft).trim() !== '') {\n        speechInputs.Additional_information = inputs.coreDraft;\n      }\n\n      const result = await DifyClient.techPublish(speechInputs, dto.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        await ChatMessageService.saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n          result,\n          '发布会稿生成',\n          'speech-generation',\n          inputs,\n          dto.conversationId\n        );\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('保存发布会稿消息失败', { error });\n      }\n\n      return success(result);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('发布会稿执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'SPEECH_GENERATION_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '发布会稿生成失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

{\\\\n        const updated = [...prev, aiMessage];\\\\n        // 在状态更新后，使用最新的消息列表自动保存\\\\n        setTimeout(async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n          await autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages(updated);\\\\n        }, 300);\\\\n        return updated;\\\\n      });\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\\\n      const errorMessage = {\\\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\\\n      };\\\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\\\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data) {\\\\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\\\\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\\\\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\\\\\\\"检索信息\\\\\\\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\\\\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\\\\n      return s.type === 'external' &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; s.url &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https');\\\\n    });\\\\n    // 互联网信息点：排除上传的文件，只包含真正的互联网信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\\\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\\\n      if (s.url &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https')) {\\\\n        return false;\\\\n      }\\\\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\\\n      return true;\\\\n    });\\\\n    \\\\n    setConfiguredResources({\\\\n      files: files,\\\\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\\\\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\\\n    try {\\\\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\\\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; response.data) {\\\\n        setProject(response.data);\\\\n      }\\\\n    } catch (error) {\\\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\\\n    } finally {\\\\n      setLoading(false);\\\\n    }\\\\n  };\\\\n\\\\n  const loadSources = async () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\\\n    setCheckingHistory(true);\\\\n    try {\\\\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\\\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\\\n        params: {\\\\n          pageType: &amp;amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;amp;#96;,\\\\n          page: 1,\\\\n          pageSize: 1000\\\\n        }\\\\n      });\\\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; {\\\\n          // 从 metadata 中解析 category\\\\n          let category: string | undefined;\\\\n          if (source.metadata) {\\\\n            if (typeof source.metadata === 'string') {\\\\n              try {\\\\n                const parsed = JSON.parse(source.metadata);\\\\n                category = parsed.category || parsed.sourceCategory;\\\\n              } catch (e) {\\\\n                // 忽略解析错误\\\\n              }\\\\n            } else if (typeof source.metadata === 'object') {\\\\n              category = source.metadata.category || source.metadata.sourceCategory;\\\\n            }\\\\n          }\\\\n          // 也检查直接设置的 category\\\\n          if (source.category) {\\\\n            category = source.category;\\\\n          }\\\\n          return category &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;         "contents": "export class ContextManager {\nprivate async applyHybridStrategy(\n    history: any[],\n    strategy: DirectAgentConfig['contextStrategy'],\n    currentQuery: string\n  ): Promise&lt;ChatMessage[]&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成摘要\n   * @param messages 消息列表\n   * @returns 摘要文本\n   */\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    if (messages.length === 0) {\n      return '';\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 构建摘要提示词\n      const conversationText = messages\n        .map(msg =&gt; {\n          const role = msg.message_type === 'user' ? '用户' : '助手';\n          const content = msg.content || msg.query || msg.dify_answer || '';\n          return &#96;${role}: ${content}&#96;;\n        })\n        .join('\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，截断（避免超出 token 限制）\n      const maxLength = 2000; // 大约 500 tokens\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '...'\n        : conversationText;\n\n      const summaryPrompt = &#96;请总结以下对话的关键信息，保留重要的上下文和细节。用中文回答，控制在100字以内。\n\n对话内容：\n${truncatedText}\n\n摘要：&#96;;\n\n      // 尝试使用环境变量中的 OpenAI API Key 生成摘要\n      // 如果没有配置，则返回简化摘要\n      const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;\n      if (apiKey) {\n        try {\n          const provider = new OpenAIProvider(apiKey);\n          const summaryMessages: ChatMessage[] = [\n            {\n              role: 'user',\n              content: summaryPrompt\n            }\n          ];\n          \n          const response = await provider.chat(summaryMessages, {\n            provider: 'openai',\n            apiKey,\n            model: 'gpt-3.5-turbo',\n            temperature: 0.3,\n            maxTokens: 200\n          });\n          \n          return response.content || '';\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('使用 LLM 生成摘要失败，使用简化摘要:', error);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 降级方案：返回简化的摘要（前200字符）\n      const text = conversationText.substring(0, 200);\n      return text + (conversationText.length &gt; 200 ? '...' : '');\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n        // 记录保存的消息内容\n        logger.info('保存AI消息', {\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          content: aiContent,\n          contentLength: aiContent.length,\n          outputsContent: cleanExtractedOutput.content,\n          outputsKeys: Object.keys(cleanExtractedOutput),\n        });\n\n        const aiMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n          params.conversationId,\n          'assistant',\n          aiContent,\n          params.sources || [],\n          [],\n          cleanExtractedOutput\n        );\n        \n        logger.info('AI消息已保存', {\n          messageId: aiMessageRecord.id,\n          content: aiMessageRecord.content,\n          contentLength: aiMessageRecord.content?.length || 0,\n        });\n\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          aiMessage: formatMessageRecord(aiMessageRecord),\n        });\n      } catch (workflowError: any) {\n        logger.error('工作流执行失败', { workflowError });\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          error: '工作流执行失败，请稍后重试',\n          errorDetail: workflowError?.message || String(workflowError),\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('发送消息失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'SEND_MESSAGE_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '发送消息失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取功能类型的中文标签\n   */\n  private getFeatureLabel(featureType: string): string {\n    const labelMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n      'five-view-analysis': '五看分析'\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AiSearchService {\nasync deleteConversation(id: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成输出内容\n   */\n  async generateOutput(\n    type: 'ppt' | 'script' | 'mindmap' | 'other',\n    conversationId: string,\n    messageId: string,\n    content: string,\n    title?: string,\n    pageType?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;OutputContentRecord&gt; {\n    const id = uuidv4();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    \n    const outputTitle = title || &#96;${type}_${new Date().toISOString()}&#96;;\n    \n    // 如果没有提供 pageType，尝试从对话中获取\n    let finalPageType = pageType;\n    if (!finalPageType) {\n      const conversationRows = await db.query(\n        &#96;SELECT page_type FROM ai_search_conversations WHERE id = ?&#96;,\n        [conversationId]\n      ) as any[];\n      if (conversationRows.length &gt; 0) {\n        finalPageType = conversationRows[0].page_type;\n      }\n    }\n\n    await db.query(\n      &#96;INSERT INTO ai_search_outputs \n       (id, type, title, content, message_id, conversation_id, page_type, created_at)\n       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)&#96;,\n      [id, type, outputTitle, JSON.stringify(content), messageId, conversationId, finalPageType || null, now]\n    );\n\n    // 更新消息的输出字段\n    const messageRows = await db.query(\n      &#96;SELECT outputs FROM ai_search_messages WHERE id = ?&#96;,\n      [messageId]\n    ) as any[];\n\n    if (messageRows.length &gt; 0) {\n      const existingOutputs = messageRows[0].outputs \n        ? JSON.parse(messageRows[0].outputs) \n        : [];\n      existingOutputs.push({\n        id,\n        type,\n        title: outputTitle,\n        content,\n        createdAt: new Date(now),\n      });\n\n      await db.query(\n        &#96;UPDATE ai_search_messages \n         SET outputs = ? \n         WHERE id = ?&#96;,\n        [JSON.stringify(existingOutputs), messageId]\n      );\n    }\n\n    return {\n      id,\n      type,\n      title: outputTitle,\n      content: JSON.stringify(content),\n      message_id: messageId,\n      conversation_id: conversationId,\n      page_type: finalPageType,\n      created_at: now,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取输出内容列表\n   */\n  async getOutputs(conversationId?: string, pageType?: string): Promise&lt;OutputContentRecord[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

## 实现总结

已实现从 tech-package 页面点击“技术策略”按钮时，将当前对话消息总结并保存为来源，然后跳转到 tech-strategy 页面并默认选中该来源。

### 主要修改：

1. **BaseAISearchPage.tsx**：
   - 添加 `summarizeAndSaveConversationForNavigation`，用于总结当前对话并保存为来源
   - 函数会：
     - 提取当前对话的所有消息
     - 生成标题和描述（使用最后一条 AI 消息的前 100 字符作为标题）
     - 保存为来源信息，使用 `tech-strategy-qa` 或 `tech-article-qa` 类别
     - 返回保存的 sourceId
   - 优化 URL 参数处理逻辑，确保新保存的来源能被正确加载和选中

2. **SourceSidebar.tsx**：
   - 添加 `currentConversation` 和 `onSummarizeAndNavigate` props
   - 修改“技术策略”和“技术通稿”按钮的点击处理：
     - 点击时先调用总结函数保存对话
     - 将保存的 sourceId 通过 URL 参数传递
     - 跳转到目标页面
     - 添加加载状态提示

### 工作流程：

1. 用户在 tech-package 页面有对话内容
2. 点击“技术策略”按钮
3. 系统自动总结当前对话消息
4. 将总结保存为来源（类别：`tech-strategy-qa`）
5. 跳转到 tech-strategy 页面，URL 包含 `sourceId` 参数
6. tech-strategy 页面加载后，自动加载来源并选中新保存的来源

### 特性：

- 自动总结对话内容
- 智能生成标题（使用最后一条 AI 消息的前 100 字符）
- 支持项目隔离（如果有 projectId，会使用项目特定的 pageType）
- 自动选中新保存的来源
- 加载状态提示，避免重复点击

功能已实现，可以测试使用。

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&gt;): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; =&gt; {\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\n    \n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &#96;project-${projectId}&#96; : undefined);\n\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\n    try {\n      // 构建对话文本\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&gt; {\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\n        return &#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&#96;;\n      }).join('\\n\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\n      const maxLength = 2000;\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\n\\n...（内容已截断）'\n        : conversationText;\n\n      // 生成总结（简化版本：使用对话内容作为描述，标题为总结）\n      // 如果对话很长，取前100字符作为标题\n      let summaryTitle = '项目资源对话摘要';\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify聊天响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyChatResponse(\n    response: DifyChatResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; userMessage: ChatMessageRecord; assistantMessage: ChatMessageRecord }&gt; {\n    // 1. 创建或更新对话会话\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      app_type: appType,\n      session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\n      status: 'active'\n    });\n\n    // 2. 保存用户消息\n    const userMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: &#96;user_${response.id}_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'user',\n      content: userQuery,\n      query: userQuery,\n      inputs: inputs ?         "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify工作流响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n    response: DifyWorkflowResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any,\n    existingConversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; workflowExecution: WorkflowExecutionRecord }&gt; {\n    // 使用传入的conversation_id或生成新的对话ID\n    const conversationId = existingConversationId || response.workflow_run_id;\n    \n    // 创建或更新对话记录\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\n      conversation_id: conversationId,\n      session_name: userQuery || &#96;${appType}工作流&#96;,\n      app_type: existingConversationId ? 'ai-search' : appType, // 如果是关联的工作流，保持原始类型\n      status: 'active',\n      metadata: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined\n    });\n\n    // 保存工作流执行记录\n    const workflowExecution = await this.saveWorkflowExecution({\n      workflow_run_id: response.workflow_run_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      workflow_id: response.data?.workflow_id,\n      app_type: appType,\n      status: response.data?.status || 'completed',\n      error_message: response.data?.error || undefined,\n      inputs: inputs ?         "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst summarizeAndSaveConversation = async \n\n\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\n      try {\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\n        const summaryPrompt = &#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\n标题：[标题]\n摘要：[摘要内容]\n\n对话内容：\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n          summaryPrompt,\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;&amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\n          undefined\n        );\n\n        if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\s*(.+)/);\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\s*(.+?)(?:\\n|$)/s);\n          \n          if (titleMatch &amp;&amp; titleMatch[1]) {\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\n          }\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;&amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\n            if (summaryDescription.length &lt; 200) {\n              summaryDescription = &#96;${summaryDescription}\\n\\n完整对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&#96;;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('使用 AI 生成总结失败，使用简化版本:', error);\n        // 如果 AI 调用失败，使用简化版本\n        summaryTitle = messagesToUse.length &gt; 0 \n          ? &#96;项目对话摘要（${messagesToUse.length}条消息）&#96;\n          : '项目对话摘要';\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      const sourceId = &#96;project_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: summaryTitle\n      };\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 总结当前对话并保存为来源，用于跳转到其他页面\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversationForNavigation = useCallback(async (targetPageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; =&gt; {\n    if (!currentConversation || !currentConversation.messages || currentConversation.messages.length === 0) {\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有对话内容，无法总结');\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 构建对话文本\n      const conversationText = currentConversation.messages.map((msg) =&gt; {\n        const role = msg.role === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\n        return &#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&#96;;\n      }).join('\\n\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\n      const maxLength = 2000;\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\n\\n...（内容已截断）'\n        : conversationText;\n\n      // 生成总结标题和描述\n      let summaryTitle = '技术包装对话摘要';\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\n\n      // 尝试从最后一条AI消息中提取关键信息作为标题\n      const lastAssistantMessage = [...currentConversation.messages]\n        .reverse()\n        .find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant');\n      \n      if (lastAssistantMessage &amp;&amp; lastAssistantMessage.content) {\n        // 取前100字符作为标题候选\n        const contentPreview = lastAssistantMessage.content.substring(0, 100).replace(/\\n/g, ' ').trim();\n        if (contentPreview.length &gt; 10) {\n          summaryTitle = contentPreview.length &gt; 50 \n            ? contentPreview.substring(0, 50) + '...'\n            : contentPreview;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      // 根据当前页面的 pageType 设置类别，而不是目标页面\n      // 因为对话是在当前页面产生的\n      const sourceId = &#96;tech_package_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      let category: SourceCategory = 'external';\n      \n      if (config.pageType === 'tech-package')\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n          input: workflowInput,\n        });\n\n        // 从工作流执行结果中提取 Dify conversation_id\n        // Agent 节点的输出中可能包含 conversation_id\n        let newDifyConversationId: string | null = null;\n        \n        // 尝试从工作流执行结果的数据中提取 conversation_id\n        // 首先检查 outputs 中是否包含 conversation_id\n        if (workflowResult?.data?.outputs) {\n          const outputs = workflowResult.data.outputs;\n          if (outputs.conversation_id &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.conversation_id === 'string') {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.output &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.output === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.output.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.output.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.metadata &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.metadata === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.metadata.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.metadata.conversation_id;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果还没有找到，尝试从 extractedOutput 中提取\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n    \n    // 只在第一次对话时，提取外部来源的文本内容（description）\n    if (isFirstMessage) {\n      const externalTextSources = effectiveSources.filter((s: any) =&gt; \n        s.type === 'external' &amp;&amp; s.description &amp;&amp; s.description.trim()\n      );\n      \n      externalTextSources.forEach((source: any) =&gt; {\n        if (source.description &amp;&amp; source.description.trim()) {\n          const title = source.title || '附加信息';\n          textContents.push(&#96;【${title}】\\n${source.description.trim()}&#96;);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加（无论是否第一次对话）\n    if (fileMarkdownContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      textContents.push(...fileMarkdownContents);\n    }\n    \n    if (textContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      additionalContext = '\\n\\n=== 附加信息（文件内容） ===\\n' + textContents.join('\\n\\n---\\n\\n');\n      logger.info('提取附加信息（外部来源和文件markdown）', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        filesCount: fileMarkdownContents.length,\n        totalTextLength: additionalContext.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 将附加信息合并到 query 中\n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加，外部来源的文本内容仅在第一次对话时添加\n    let finalQuery = params.content;\n    if (additionalContext) {\n      finalQuery = params.content + additionalContext;\n      logger.info('合并附加信息到查询内容', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        originalLength: params.content.length,\n        additionalLength: additionalContext.length,\n        finalLength: finalQuery.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 检查上一条消息是否是子Agent（工具箱）生成的内容\n    // 主Agent和子Agent交叉对话的逻辑：\n    // 1. 主对话使用同一个 dify_conversation_id 保持多轮对话\n    // 2. 子Agent（五看、三定等）处理上下文窗口内容，生成分析结果\n    // 3. 当用户继续主对话时，如果上一条是子Agent的输出，则将其作为上下文传递给主Agent\n    let toolOutputContext = '';\n    if (!isFirstMessage &amp;&amp; context.history &amp;&amp; context.history.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 找到最后一条助手消息\n      const lastAssistantMessage = [...context.history]\n        .reverse()\n        .find;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const AIChatPage: React.FC = \nconst handleSendMessage = async \n\n      \n      if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data) {\n        // 处理不同的返回格式\n        if (result.data.result) {\n          responseContent = result.data.result;\n        } else if (result.data.answer) {\n          responseContent = result.data.answer;\n        } else {\n          responseContent = \"抱歉，未能获取到有效回答。\";\n        }\n\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\n        if (result.data.conversation_id &amp;&amp; result.data.conversation_id !== conversationId) {\n          setConversationId(result.data.conversation_id);\n          console.log('🔄 AIChatPage更新conversation_id:', result.data.conversation_id);\n        } else if (result.data.conversationId &amp;&amp; result.data.conversationId !== conversationId) {\n          setConversationId(result.data.conversationId);\n          console.log('🔄 AIChatPage更新conversationId:', result.data.conversationId);\n        }\n      } else if (result.error) {\n        responseContent = &#96;处理请求时出现问题：${result.error}&#96;;\n      }\n\n      const aiMessage: Message = {\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\n        content: responseContent,\n        sender: \"ai\",\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n      };\n      \n      setMessages((prev) =&gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\n      \n      const errorMessage: Message = {\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\n        content: &#96;抱歉，服务暂时不可用。错误信息：${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n        sender: \"ai\",\n        timestamp: new Date(),\n      };\n      \n      setMessages((prev) =&gt; [...prev, errorMessage]);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleWorkflowSelect = (workflowId: string, workflowName: string) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedWorkflow(workflowName);\n    // 这里可以添加切换工作流的逻辑\n  };\n\n  // 快捷操作处理函数\n  const handleCopyMessage = async (content: string)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const userMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        params.conversationId,\n        'user',\n        params.content,\n        params.sources || [],\n        params.files || []\n      );\n\n      const conversationRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(params.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        const requestedWorkflowId = params.workflowId;\n        const finalWorkflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n\n        if (!finalWorkflowId) {\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const mappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, finalWorkflowId);\n\n        if (!mappingConfig) {\n          const message =\n            requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === finalWorkflowId\n              ? &#96;所选工作流(${finalWorkflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n              : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: message,\n            errorDetail: '请在字段映射配置中为该工作流完成输入输出映射',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const conversationData = await this.buildConversationData({\n          conversation: conversationRecord,\n          content: params.content,\n          sources: params.sources,\n          files: params.files,\n          contextWindowSize: params.contextWindowSize,\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          fileList: params.fileList,\n          knowledgeBaseNames: params.knowledgeBaseNames,\n        });\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n  }\n}",

'用户' : 'AI助手';\n        return &#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&#96;;\n      }).join('\\n\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\n      const maxLength = 2000;\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? ## 实现总结

已实现自动保存对话记录功能，确保每个子页面的 AI 对话都会生成独立记录，并在页面切换时只显示当前页面的记录。

### 主要功能：

1. **自动保存对话记录**：
   - 在 `handleMessageSent` 中，每次 AI 对话完成后自动保存为来源记录
   - 使用 `autoSaveConversationAsSource` 函数处理保存逻辑
   - 确保至少有一轮完整问答（至少一条用户消息和一条 AI 消息）才保存

2. **每个对话只保存一次最新记录**：
   - 使用 `conversation_${conversation.id}_${pageType}` 作为 sourceId
   - 如果已存在该对话的记录，先删除旧的再创建新的，确保始终是最新记录

3. **正确的类别和页面类型**：
   - 根据当前页面的 `pageType` 自动设置类别：
     - `tech-package` → `tech-package-qa`（技术包装问答）
     - `tech-strategy` → `tech-strategy-qa`（技术策略问答）
     - `tech-article` → `tech-article-qa`（技术通稿问答）
   - 保存时使用当前页面的 `pageType`（支持项目隔离）

4. **页面切换时只显示当前页面的记录**：
   - 修改了 `loadPageTypeSources`，只加载当前页面的来源
   - 切换页面时，清除其他页面的来源，只保留：
     - 当前页面的对话记录来源
     - 当前页面的文件来源
   - 添加了 `useEffect` 监听页面类型和项目 ID 变化，自动重新加载来源

### 工作流程：

1. 用户在任意子页面（tech-package/tech-strategy/tech-article）进行 AI 对话
2. 对话完成后，系统自动保存为来源记录
3. 来源记录显示在“来源”侧边栏中，带有对应的类别标签
4. 切换到其他页面时，自动加载该页面的来源记录
5. 每个对话只保留一条最新记录，更新时会替换旧记录

功能已实现，可以测试使用。
